title: A* on a weighted grid
hints: Store `(f, -g, cell)` tuples in a min-heap: it pops the smallest f, and among equal f the largest g, because `-g` is then the smallest.
Count an expansion only after the stale check (`if (-negG > g[cell]) continue;`), and keep a `parent` array, set whenever a cell's `g` improves, to rebuild the path from the goal.
